cases.question: Does CCL supply instant coffee that other businesses sell under their own labels?
cases.support_notes: Private-label instant coffee, bulk exports and premium European clients. Do not imply all sales are private label.

cases.question: What does the July call say about the cost-plus model and whether lower green coffee prices change the margin profile?
cases.support_notes: Management says margin profile does not change; inventory carrying cost and calmer contracting are separate benefits.

cases.question: How do Infosys Cobalt and Topaz differ?
cases.support_notes: Cobalt: enterprise cloud journey. Topaz: AI-first services and platforms.

cases.question: How does Polycab use FIFO and inventory discipline to reduce stock ageing?
cases.support_notes: MSCA, handheld devices, Oracle ERP and system-driven FIFO. Planned extensions must not be described as completed.

cases.question: What opportunity does management see in supplying data centres, and what advantages does it cite?
cases.support_notes: Already supplies conventional parts. R&D, capabilities, distribution and product portfolio support opportunity; forecasts are not realised orders.

cases.question: In the October call, had management settled on the country for the next freeze-dried expansion?
cases.support_notes: No decision. India and Vietnam both permit brownfield expansion. Possible capacity is not committed capex.

cases.question: How does the Infosys Group protect itself when exchange rates move against overseas cash flows?
cases.support_notes: Consolidated Group disclosure: foreign-exchange forward and option contracts mitigate currency exposures; risk is not eliminated.

cases.question: Which client industries were weak in the October call, and what did management attribute the weakness to?
cases.support_notes: Hi-Tech and Retail: discretionary ramp-downs and client-specific slowdowns. Retail also had smaller third-party component. Attribute to management.

cases.question: What products are included in Polycab's FMEG business beyond wires and cables?
cases.support_notes: Fans, switches/switchgear, lighting, conduit pipes/fittings and solar inverters; wires/cables are separate.

cases.question: When coffee becomes expensive, do drinkers stop buying it or switch to a cheaper kind?
cases.support_notes: Management describes price-inelastic consumption, with possible freeze-dried to spray-dried mix shifts. Commentary is not an independently established forecast.

cases.question: What is CCL's exact audited consolidated revenue for FY2030?
cases.support_notes: Future period absent. Must abstain; no extrapolated financial figures.

cases.question: What is the private mobile telephone number of the Infosys chief executive?
cases.support_notes: Private contact detail absent. Must abstain rather than invent or infer.

cases.question: Which activities does Gokaldas bring together on its integrated apparel platform?
cases.support_notes: Design, product development, sourcing, manufacturing, finishing and logistics. No founding-year claim is needed.

cases.question: Where outside India does it make garments?
cases.support_notes: Manufacturing platform includes Kenya and Ethiopia. Distinguish factories from overseas marketing offices.

cases.question: In the May call, how did it share import-duty pressure with its buyers and suppliers?
cases.support_notes: Management describes discounts passed to customers net of discounts imposed on its supply chain. Attribute the account to management; do not invent permanent contract terms.
